title: Codec confirmation: the searched settings over seeds, with fixed-width and unconstrained references
description: Confirms the winner of the codec search (release exp-codec-search-3: learning rate 1e-3, encoder and decoder width 512, encoder depth 4, weight decay 1e-4, chosen by the lowest validation loss) on all training anchors of release exp-phase0-steps-2 (links split 70/15/15, split seed 0), 10 epochs with cosine decay and early stopping. Three kinds of model (experiments/codec.py; docs/methodology.md): nested16, 16 ordered latents trained with nested dropout, seeds 0 to 4; wide64, 64 latents all kept, the reference without a narrow layer, seeds 0 to 4; fixedK, K latents all kept, for K in 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, seeds 0 to 2, which shows what ordering costs at each width. Scores are on validation links only; the test links are not read. The trained weights are kept in the release.
run: MODEL=${JOB%-s*}; SEED=${JOB##*-s}; case "$MODEL" in nested16) K=16; NESTED=true;; wide64) K=64; NESTED=false;; fixed*) K=${MODEL#fixed}; NESTED=false;; *) exit 2;; esac; uv run python experiments/codec.py train "$OUT/runs/$JOB" --data "$IN/steps" --set k=$K --set nested=$NESTED --set seed=$SEED --set lr=0.001 --set width=512 --set depth=4 --set dec_width=512 --set weight_decay=0.0001 --set epochs=10 --set time_budget_s=18000
